summary: Multi-tenant education platform. Auth + core LMS solid; ERP/EduOS wired; gaps in notification delivery, smartboard, production hardening.

modules.label: Authentication
modules.note: Unified login (one screen) + signup.html across website/marketplace. Google OAuth still demo stub.

modules.label: Marketplace
modules.note: Browse/purchase wired. Website now fetches live API data. Pagination+category filter bug remains.

modules.label: Student LMS
modules.note: Courses/tests/assignments/reader live. Reader has topic detail view with images/attachments/AI-assist.

modules.label: Live Classes
modules.note: Jitsi + polls. No breakout rooms / recording pipeline.

modules.label: Smartboard
modules.note: Not built. Browser can do region-share/canvas/record only.

modules.label: AI Tools
modules.note: AI endpoints exist; UI assist buttons on forms + reader (summarize/explain/tutor); OCR stubbed.

modules.label: Responsive UI
modules.note: Mobile/tablet/ultrawide/TV/smartboard-touch breakpoints all done. Only smartboard app mode untested.

modules.label: Notifications
modules.note: SendGrid/Twilio/WhatsApp/FCM wired with real API calls. Falls back to console-stub without keys.

modules.label: Payments
modules.note: Razorpay wired with webhook verification; student receipt PDF; teacher invoice PDF; coupons; refund. Live keys needed to verify end-to-end.

issues.title: 3 roles had no dashboard
issues.detail: corporate_trainer/content_creator/franchise landed on blank screen.
issues.fix: Added role sections + render fns + nav.

issues.title: Notification delivery fully stubbed
issues.detail: eduos.js returns fake externalId even with SENDGRID/TWILIO/FCM keys set; nothing sends.
issues.fix: Wired real SendGrid v3 mail/send, Twilio SMS, WhatsApp Cloud API, FCM push — all with actual HTTP calls, error handling, and fallback to console-stub.

issues.title: In-memory OTP + login throttle
issues.detail: otpStore/_attempts lost on restart, don't scale, OTP stored plaintext.
issues.fix: OTP now stored as SHA-256 hash in jeetmantra_otps DB table with TTL; falls back to in-memory if table missing. Rate-limit remains in-memory (single-node acceptable).

issues.title: Soft-delete not enforced on reads
issues.detail: status:'deleted' set but user reads don't filter it -> deleted users still visible.
issues.fix: Added .neq('status','deleted') to admin user list, dashboard counts, n8n sync.

issues.title: No DB transactions on multi-row writes
issues.detail: Course duplicate etc. can leave orphan rows on partial failure.
issues.fix: Added rollback-on-failure cleanup to course duplicate (deletes partial data in reverse dependency order). Supabase JS doesn't support multi-table transactions natively.

issues.title: Pagination + category filter bug
issues.detail: Category filter applied after range() so pages return < limit items.
issues.fix: Category filter now uses courses!inner join, applied before .range(). Includes fallback for missing inner join support.

issues.title: Smartboard / OBS mode missing
issues.detail: USP not started. Region share, canvas crop, annotations, MediaRecorder are browser-feasible; perspective/virtual-cam need native.
issues.fix: Phase A: web-feasible scene/region/record. Phase B: native bridge.

issues.title: Live Razorpay capture unverified + no PDF invoice
issues.detail: Runs demo mode without keys; invoice PDF (task #126) open.
issues.fix: Webhook signature verification already solid. Added GET /payments/:id/receipt for student-facing HTML receipt (print-to-PDF). Teacher invoice PDF already existed in teacherExtras.

issues.title: Smartboard / TV / ultrawide breakpoints untested
issues.detail: Layouts verified to tablet; large touch displays unhandled.
issues.fix: Added @media >=1600px and >=2000px breakpoints (wider sidebar, more grid cols, larger text) + pointer:coarse touch-target sizing (44px+ min-height).

issues.title: Silent error swallowing
issues.detail: catch(_){} in activity.js, eduos.js, aiProvider.js masks bugs.
issues.fix: Added console.warn or descriptive comments to all empty catch blocks in app code.

issues.title: No forum moderation
issues.detail: Threads/replies can't be deleted/flagged -> spam vector.
issues.fix: Added POST /forum/flag/:type/:id, DELETE /forum/thread/:id, DELETE /forum/reply/:id endpoints.

issues.title: N+1 dashboard queries
issues.detail: Per-enrollment lecture_progress lookups.
issues.fix: Replaced Promise.all(enrollments.map(async => 2 queries)) with 2 batched .in() queries regardless of enrollment count.

issues.title: Orphaned enhancement file
issues.detail: jeetmantra-enhance.html was unused.
issues.fix: Inlined a dashboard-scoped layer.

issues.title: Theme applied on dashboard only
issues.detail: Accent/logo/font didn't reach login/marketplace/admin/liveRoom.
issues.fix: Added shared jm-theme.js to all pages.

issues.title: Inconsistent login screens
issues.detail: website.html had its own React login; marketplace used /login.html; signup linked to website?tab=login. Three different experiences.
issues.fix: Unified on /login.html (branded BG) + /signup.html. Website + marketplace + signup all route to the same screens.

issues.title: Book Demo not gated behind auth
issues.detail: Anyone could book a demo without logging in. No user record captured.
issues.fix: All Book Demo / Enroll buttons now check jm_token; redirect to /login.html if absent.

issues.title: Website showed static demo data
issues.detail: CoursesPage and DirectoryPage used hardcoded arrays instead of live API.
issues.fix: Both now fetch from /api/courses and /api/users, falling back to static data if API fails.

issues.title: Topic images + attachments
issues.detail: Topics had only title/description, no media.
issues.fix: Added image (multi) and attachment file inputs to topic inline forms; tree items show thumbnails and attachment badges.

issues.title: Student reading panel — topic detail
issues.detail: Reader only showed lectures; clicking a topic folder did nothing.
issues.fix: Topics now clickable in TOC, opening a detail view with description, images, attachments, and AI buttons.

issues.title: AI-assist buttons across editors
issues.detail: AI buttons only on course create wizard.
issues.fix: Added AI Assist on inline forms (topics/lectures/materials), Summarize/Explain on reader lectures and topics.

issues.title: jm-theme.js missing from website.html
issues.detail: Global theme did not apply to the main website/landing page.
issues.fix: Added <script src=/jm-theme.js> to website.html.

nextActions: JM-007 Build Phase-A web smartboard (scenes + region share + record) — major feature, separate project.
Set up SENDGRID_API_KEY / TWILIO env vars and test real notification delivery.
Create jeetmantra_otps table in Supabase (phone TEXT PRIMARY KEY, otp_hash TEXT, expiry TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ).
Test Razorpay in live mode with real keys — webhook + client-side flow.
Add Google OAuth real integration (currently demo stub).
